request.deadline: 12-month grant period beginning after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Part-time maintainer for Dolos over 12 months after the existing contract closes
Essential codebase maintenance including dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and documentation
Community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public developer communication
AI-friendly documentation and integration resources for AI-driven development workflows
request.recipient: TxPipe via Intersect treasury management smart contracts
request.what: Fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2, including maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, composed of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.
The on-chain treasury withdrawal reward is 540,750,000,000 lovelace to the listed 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address.
The proposal says the core maintenance request is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Dolos maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.

Dolos is described as a lightweight open-source Cardano data node in Rust that indexes ledger primitives and exposes multiple query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C socket.
The proposal states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer scope includes dependency updates, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixes, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and AI-friendly resources.
The proposal asserts it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved framework.
The proposal asserts the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at submission.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with listed TRSC and PSSC addresses, multisignature-style role thresholds, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.

The proposal states TxPipe has received 30 Project Catalyst grants across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development on schedule, and that prior Intersect 2025 open-source maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC is being delivered on schedule.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance continuation administered by Intersect, with open-source infrastructure benefits, governance-process references, smart-contract oversight details, and some externally checkable claims, but key delivery-history and cost-basis assertions are largely proposer-stated.
